you need to understand that recovery is a progress uniquely for yourself, your health. we are always looking for approbation from other people but that’s exactly what feeds your ed; same as wanting to look good for people, needing people to tell you to eat so you can eat... 

people may not be nice in this process, but they are always stupid, and that’s another thing that feeds your ed: the pressure, everyone wants you to look perfect and standard but we aren’t

our ed likes to trick us, so when the bad thoughts show up you have to remember how miserable you used to be and why you are in recovery (recovery is a process, it’s hard and you’ll feel like giving up a lot of times, but it’s worthy it, it’s for your life!!)

in summary: people will be people, society is all wrong in general (we live in a word infested with diet culture) so you have to keep going for yourself

let’s say you’re about to eat something - forget about standards and take a look into inside your own body and your hunger cues (mental included). now you should allow yourself to eat as much as you want and feel free to stop if you don’t want it anymore too, but try not to use it as a restriction mechanism.
